title: Analysis of the implementation of "riblets structures" in a commercial airliner
author: Thiago Fernandes de Freitas
abstract: This paper will cover the topic of friction drag reduction and a consequent reduction in fuel consumption through the use of slots in the outer area of an aircraft. Such technology is derived from the mid-70s and 80s and is commonly described as "shark skin effect". Its origin dates back to the name: it is an attempt to copy the skin of fast sharks. At work this topic is discussed and an analysis of the total money that can be saved with the use of such technology when applied in a commercial aircraft. It will also deal with subjects related to marketing and implementation of a new aircraft paint it receives a print out of such configuration as desired. Follow the approach of this application and analysis of the structure.
